subject: reasoning
question: Ram is the only brother of Rupa, who is the only daughter of Maya. If Shyam is the only son of Pushpa, who is the paternal grandmother of Ram, then how is Maya related to Pushpa?
solution:
The family chart is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1fe9ab3dacc543807a2678698ddb41719e81d30f4eac76f273a4d30876cf59b.png] 

Drawing the family tree,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9a7b5b52c24b2ba8fdbc9afe09f86fd7915b97a3a8379fad6fc11f3a31bf6cf.png] 

Here, we can see that **Shyam is the husband of Maya and Pushpa is Shyam's mother**.

So, Maya is Daughter - in - law of Pushpa.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Daughter - in - law"**.
